name: leader message semiote
normative-structure: The semiote performs one bounded linguistic observation under a named language map, preserving the immutable source, ambiguity, contradiction, and repair obligations. It proposes no authoritative reading of the Leader and cannot write the customer settlement.
refuses: using a language map not admitted by the colony

revised.why: reports-to named the linguistics section, which is no office; the semiote reports to no office and answers through the polity that seats it (organizing/agency/control).
